message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code uses 'dvc pull' to fetch remote data but performs no checksum verification, signature check, or authentication of the remote source beyond what DVC itself may provide internally.
No detected label flipping detection: The code does not validate label distributions, compare label values against an expected set, or use any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The clean_dataset function only removes '?', nulls, and duplicates; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering mechanisms.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model.joblib, encoder.joblib, and lb.joblib via joblib.load() with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before deserialization.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous label distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The model is trained with a standard sklearn RandomForestClassifier with no differential privacy library or mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the codebase.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation enforcement of a held-out test set, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and while multiple metrics (precision, recall, fbeta) are computed, there are no controls preventing metric manipulation or ensuring the evaluation data was not seen during training.

No detected output bounds checks: The inference path returns the model prediction directly via lb.inverse_transform without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or output validation before returning to the caller.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular classification model (RandomForestClassifier), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
